description: Airports of Falkland Islands (Malvinas) is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT). Airports and aviation infrastructure: airports, heliports, helipads, runways, terminals, and emergency landing sites tagged via aeroway, building, or emergency. Useful for logistics, evacuation routing, and aerial-response planning. Coverage reflects where volunteer mappers have been active. Urban areas are usually well represented, remote areas may be sparse. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. Coverage: Falkland Islands (Malvinas). The portal files it under the publisher Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT). Its tags are aviation, facilities-infrastructure, geodata. It offers 11 resource(s) in GEOJSON, GEOPACKAGE, HTML, JSON, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODC-ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
